title: Saturday at the cinema
situation_ru: Бен и Хлоя договариваются сходить в кино.
situation_en: Two friends, Ben and Chloe, are making plans to go to the cinema.
script:
Ben: Hi Chloe! Do you want to see the new Space Cats film on Saturday?
Chloe: Yes! But not in the morning. I've got a swimming lesson until twelve.
Ben: OK. There's a show at two fifteen and one at five thirty.
Chloe: Let's go to the earlier one. My mum wants me home for dinner.
Ben: Cool. Tickets are eight pounds, but with a student card they're six.
Chloe: Great, I've got my card. Shall we get popcorn?
Ben: It's really expensive there. I'll bring some snacks from home.
Chloe: Good idea. Where shall we meet?
Ben: In front of the cinema, ten minutes before the start.
Chloe: Perfect. See you on Saturday!

questions.q: What does Chloe do on Saturday morning?
options: She has lunch with her mum
questions.explain_ru: «I've got a swimming lesson until twelve».

questions.q: What time will they see the film?
questions.explain_ru: «Let's go to the earlier one» — это 2:15.

questions.q: How much will Chloe pay for her ticket?
questions.explain_ru: Со студенческой картой — six pounds; карта у Хлои есть.

title: School Radio
situation_ru: Эми из 8C рассказывает школьные новости недели по школьному радио.
situation_en: Amy from class 8C reads the weekly news on the school radio.
script: Amy: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to School Radio! I'm Amy from class 8C. Here's the news for this week. [pause 1s] First, the school talent show is on Thursday at four o'clock in the main hall. If you want to sing, dance or do magic tricks, write your name on the list outside room twelve before Wednesday. [pause 1s] Second, the library has twenty new books, and most of them are comics — so no excuses! [pause 1s] And finally, some bad news: the basketball court is closed this week because they're painting it. PE lessons will be in the gym. That's all from me. Have a great week!

title: New headphones
situation_ru: Лили выбирает беспроводные наушники в магазине.
situation_en: Lily is buying wireless headphones in a shop.
script:
Assistant: Hi there, can I help you?
Lily: Yes, I'm looking for some wireless headphones. Something not too expensive.
Assistant: OK. These black ones are really popular. They're forty-five dollars.
Lily: Hmm, that's a bit too much. I've only got thirty-five.
Assistant: Then try these. They're thirty dollars, and the battery lasts twenty hours.
Lily: Twenty hours? That's longer than my old ones. What colours have you got?
Assistant: White, pink and green.
Lily: Green, please! All my friends have got white ones, and I want to be different.
Assistant: Good choice. Do you need a bag?
Lily: No, thanks. I'll put them in my backpack.

Why does Lily choose that colour?
options: She wants to look different from her friends
Her best friend has got the same ones
questions.explain_ru: «All my friends have got white ones, and I want to be different».

title: The camping trip
situation_ru: Джек рассказывает другу в голосовом сообщении, как его семья ездила в кемпинг.
situation_en: Jack leaves his friend a voice message about his family's camping trip.
script: Jack: Hey, it's Jack. You asked about our camping trip, so here's the story. [pause 1s] We arrived at the campsite on Friday evening, and it was raining. Dad couldn't put up the tent, so we slept in the car! [pause 1s] On Saturday the sun came out, and we went kayaking on the lake. My sister fell in the water, but she was OK — she was wearing a life jacket. [pause 1s] In the evening we cooked sausages on a fire. They were black on the outside, but they tasted amazing. We're going again in August. You should come with us!

title: A present for a friend
situation_ru: Эмма выбирает подарок подруге в магазине.
situation_en: Emma is buying a birthday present for her friend in a shop.
script:
Emma: Hi! I want a present for my friend. She's twelve.
Assistant: OK. What does she like?
Emma: She loves music, and she's got a cat.
Assistant: What about this T-shirt? It's got a cat in headphones on it.
Emma: Ha-ha, that's funny! How much is it?
Assistant: It's fifteen pounds.
Emma: Hmm. I've only got ten pounds.
Assistant: Then what about these cat socks? They're seven pounds.
Emma: Perfect! And can I have a birthday card too?
Assistant: Sure. The cards are two pounds. So that's nine pounds, please.

situation_en: Sam, a group leader, tells the group the plan for the day at summer camp.
script: Sam: Hi everyone, and welcome to Sunny Lake Camp! I'm Sam, your group leader. Here's the plan for today. [pause 1s] Breakfast is at eight o'clock in the big tent. After breakfast, at nine, we've got swimming in the lake. Please don't forget your towels! [pause 1s] Lunch is at one. In the afternoon, you can choose: football or art. And in the evening, there's a disco! [pause 1s] Oh, and one more thing: no phones at dinner. OK? Let's have a great day!

title: Where are you, Lucy?
situation_ru: Макс звонит Люси: они договорились встретиться в торговом центре.
situation_en: Max calls Lucy. They want to meet at the shopping centre.
script:
Max: Hi Lucy, I'm at the shopping centre. Where are you?
Lucy: I'm in the café on the second floor, next to the bookshop.
Max: Which café? There are two cafés here!
Lucy: The small one with green chairs. I'm sitting by the window.
Max: OK. What are you wearing?
Lucy: A yellow jacket and a black hat. And I'm eating a big ice cream!
Max: Ha! I can see you now. Wait. Is that my ice cream?
Lucy: Sorry! You're late. Come on, I can buy you a new one.
